page.layout: One page of text, one column. Running head at top left, page number at top right. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right, signature mark at the lower left.

main_text.p: Papatu diabolico hucusq; foüentur ac defendun-tur. Huius fraternitatis, in Alphonso Baptista me-minisse videtur:
Hi filo insertis numerant sua murmura baccis,

Ex Mari magno Ioannis Mariæ Polutiani: Anno Domini 1474. quosdam Carmelitas theologos, in causis fidei, inquisitores (ut vocant) haeretica prauitatis, Dominicani, infidijs ac variis molestationibus per Italiam vexabant: quorum unum legi fuisse Iulianum de Brixia, eximium diuini verbi praeconem: alium, Petrum Neuolarium, pro quo Mantuanus scripsit Apologiam in tribus libris. Sed id totum, per pontificem Sixtu, Christophori Mar-tignoni cura confopitum est. Qui Sixtum monachorum tutor, ut in Pontificum vitis testatur Ioannes Stella, omnes mendicantes ad æmulationes cui-tandas[?], in priuilegijs & gratijs censuit æquales esse.
main_text.head: 159. INNOCENTIVS octauus.
main_text.p: Innocentius octauus, patria Genuensis, ex patre Arone, Ioannes Baptista Cibo antea nuncupatus, ex D. Ceciliæ presbytero Cardinale, rex locusta-rum[?], monachorum ac sacrificulorum, Papa videli-cet, post Sixtum creabatur. Pauper olim puer erat (ut Volaterranus scribit) præstanti forma tamen: & inter Alphonsi Siciliarum regis ministros nutritus,

page.notes: Running head reads "ACTIS · LIBER · VI" with stray marks between words; transcribed as ACTIS LIBER VI. Several words in the bottom half of the page are faint or smudged; "cui-tandas", "locusta-rum" and "aulicæ" are doubtful. The line "Hi filo insertis…" is set as a separate verse line, probably a quotation. Small reference marks in the margins (left and right, near the "Sixtum" and "Pauper" lines) have no matching notes and are not transcribed.
